name: Geely Automobile Holdings Limited
summary: Geely Automobile Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, operates as an automobile manufacturer primarily in the People's Republic of China. The company engages in the research and development, production, marketing, and sale of passenger vehicles; automobile parts; and related automobile components, including electric powertrain and battery systems, as well as provides related after-sales and technical services.
